summary: Rings concept: CardType.Ring (already in the enum) placed in Zone.Home; recruitment as a granted Additional Battle Action scoped to the specific Ring (not a forced interrupt, per the user's own simplification), reusing the existing Additional Action primitive wholesale; Enlightenment victory (all 5 real elemental keywords in play at StartTurn, Fudo excludes False Rings); discard-from-hand-to-use-without-cost (extends the existing Strategy-from-hand zone check/discard-after-use to CardType.Ring). Wired 6 real Rings (Air, Water, the Void, False Air, False Water -- Ring of Fire set aside, issue #195, its own local scan/text is uncertain) plus reviewed and wired 2 previously Ring-blocked cards (Moshi Ikako, Scholarly Hermit). All 8 are training-fixture-only: none of their scan images are downloaded locally, only receipt metadata (issue #196) -- package_ring_wave_1.py is written and ready once scans exist. Purely rules-lane code (src/L5R.Core, tests, tools/content, docs) -- no client file touched at all this time; marked shared only because docs/ROADMAP.md and docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx are the collaboration audit's own shared-doc convention.
validation: 119/119 core tests (7 new: EnlightenmentVictory, RingOfAir, RingOfWater, RingOfTheVoid, FalseRingOfAir, FalseRingOfWater, RingBlockedCardsReview), 34/34 published tests, 8/8 deck-format tests, 13/13 AI tests, 5/5 server integration, 4/4 client transport integration -- all run directly (dotnet run per test project plus python3 -m unittest for the two Python suites) rather than via tools/check.sh, because this task's own git worktree has an empty .cache/nuget (gitignored) and check.sh's env.sh redirects NUGET_PACKAGES there, triggering a full cold restore that exceeded a reasonable command timeout; every constituent check check.sh would run was executed directly and confirmed green.
remaining: Ring of Earth, the Twenty Festivals printing of Ring of Fire, False Ring of Earth, False Ring of Fire, and False Ring of the Void each need an unbuilt subsystem (Interrupt timing, Dueling, Engage timing, or adjustable max hand size) -- see docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx blocker notes. All 8 wired cards await scan images (issue #196) before publishing. Ring of Fire (Emperor Edition printing) needs a verified source (issue #195).
